heading: INT. ABANDONED BOWLING ALLEY CONVERTED INTO A GOAT YOGA STUDIO - MORNING

units.text: INT. ABANDONED BOWLING ALLEY CONVERTED INTO A GOAT YOGA STUDIO - MORNING
Sun slants through the old neon pins.
The lanes are covered in rubber mats, and seven goats in tiny sweaters stand about like mildly disappointed customers.
The air smells of lavender and hay.
PERPETUA OKAFOR-LINDQVIST, 40s, instructor and owner, stands on lane four in a lilac unitard, hands pressed together.
Her student, HOLDEN BAXTER, 30s, a nervous accountant, holds a downward dog while a goat named Kevin stands on his back and chews his shirt.
At the shoe counter, BRIDGET MULLANEY, 70s, the landlady, counts rent in a ledger with a pen she clicks like a metronome.
Perpetua's cellphone buzzes on the ball return.
Breathe into your sit bones, Holden.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: I don't think I have sit bones.
units.name: HOLDEN

units.text: Everyone has sit bones.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: Kevin is eating my collar.
units.name: HOLDEN

units.text: That's Kevin's way of saying he trusts you.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: The phone buzzes again.
The speaker clicks on by itself.
Perp, it's Spencer from the county. We need to talk about the permit.
units.name: SPENCER

units.text: Spencer, I'm in a flow.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: There's a complaint. About, uh, the goats and the fire code.
units.name: SPENCER

units.text: Bridget stops clicking.
A goat bleats.
Another follows.
Holden collapses into a puddle and Kevin steps off him, unbothered.
The fire code. I told you.
units.name: BRIDGET

units.text: You told me nothing, Bridget.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: I told you in March.
units.name: BRIDGET

units.text: A new figure enters through the fire door, backlit: MARCEL DUPUIS-OGUNDE, 50s, a health inspector in a crisp gray suit, clipboard clutched like a shield.
A goat sniffs his cuff.
He lifts his pen.
Ms. Okafor-Lindqvist?
units.name: MARCEL

units.text: Namaste, officer.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: Inspector. I'm here about the livestock.
units.name: MARCEL

units.text: They're not livestock. They're faculty.
units.name: HOLDEN

units.text: Marcel writes something.
Kevin eats the page.
Hello? Is anyone there?
units.name: SPENCER

units.text: Perpetua closes her eyes, breathes in, and turns the phone face down.
